title: National Environmental Policy Act – NEPA (Luật Chính sách Môi trường Quốc gia)

versions.text:
National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) – 42 USC §4321 et seq.
§102(2)(C): Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) required for major federal actions significantly affecting the quality of the human environment. Council on Environmental Quality (CEQ) regulations: 40 CFR Parts 1500-1508. Categorical exclusions. Environmental assessments (EA). Finding of No Significant Impact (FONSI).
